h: Man remanded in Kuje over alleged threat to leak Kano Governor Yusuf's private images
p: A Federal High Court in Abuja has remanded Sanusi Dankaka at Kuje Correctional Centre over an alleged threat to leak private images of Kano State Governor Abba Yusuf. The case will continue at a later date.
more: The defendant is said to have been remanded pending further court proceedings.
